name: Aloo Chana Rasedar
ingredients: Ginger, jeera, hing, coriander and 1 tsp oil
steps: Add diced boiled potato and kala chana.
Add water and mash a few chickpeas to thicken.
note: Use more kala chana and less potato.

inspirationReferences.title: Aloo Rasedar Recipe
inspirationReferences.note: North Indian potato-in-gravy technique; our kala-chana-forward balance is an original variation.
